invariant_assessment.INV-1_tenant_data_isolation: NOT-APPLICABLE. No Ecto schema, migration, or business-table query is touched by this diff (confirmed: git diff --name-only shows no priv/repo/migrations/ file and no *_schema*.ex file; the only lib/ file changed is lib/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox.ex, a pure in-memory Lua VM state constructor with no Repo call). Sandbox construction has no I/O at all.
invariant_assessment.INV-2_server_side_field_authorisation: NOT-APPLICABLE. No API response type or field-serialisation path is touched (S4 not started; unrelated to this diff regardless).
invariant_assessment.INV-3_untrusted_runtime_sandboxing: APPLIES and SATISFIED. This is the first S5 requirement and decision 0014 (status: decided, 2026-08-23) is the build-vs-bind decision record INV-3's Reference names as the precondition for concreteness -- it now exists, so INV-3 is live for this diff, which is literally the sandbox construction boundary. Verified: (a) no host capability/function is added by this module at all (design explicitly scopes 'No host API' out -- confirmed no Lua.set!/deflua call anywhere in sandbox.ex); (b) no ambient network access is possible -- confirmed by reading deps/lua/lib/lua/vm/stdlib.ex's @libraries list directly: only String, Math, Table, Utf8, Os, Debug are installed, no socket/network library exists in the dependency at all (grep -rln 'socket\|Socket\|:gen_tcp\|:httpc' deps/lua/lib/ returned zero hits); (c) no ambient filesystem access is possible -- io/file do not exist as globals in this runtime (verified in design doc against deps/lua source directly, re-confirmed by the per-path denial test suite's 'nil or raises' assertions), and the real installed filesystem-adjacent surface (os.execute [not installed], os.tmpname [installed], package/require/load/dofile [installed]) is denied in the 28-entry deny-set, which is passed as the sandboxed: option on every construction path (single call site, grep -rn 'Lua\.new(' lib --include=*.ex -> exactly one hit, lib/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox.ex:206). No script-granted capability set exists yet (deferred to REQ-152/153/157/159/160 per design scope), so the 'gated by an explicit host-capability allowlist' half of INV-3's rule is vacuously satisfied the same way this design treats vacuous deny-set entries: there is no host capability surface exposed at all yet for a capability set to gate.
invariant_assessment.INV-4_secrets_by_reference_only: APPLIES (live per file text) but NOT TRIGGERED by this diff -- no secret material (API key, webhook signing key, OIDC secret, DB URL) is introduced, read, or serialised anywhere in this change. Verified: grep -rn "System.get_env" config/ lib/ --include=*.ex --include=*.exs filtered for lua-related hits returned none, and grep -rniE '(password|secret|client_secret|token)\\s*(=|:)\\s*"[^"]{8,}"' lib/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox.ex returned zero hits.
invariant_assessment.INV-5_not_found_forbidden_indistinguisha: NOT-APPLICABLE. No lookup-by-ID endpoint exists in this diff (S4 not started).
invariant_assessment.INV-6_new_data_access_paths_prove_scopin: SATISFIED by this handoff's own existence -- this is the meta-invariant SECURITY-REVIEWER enforces; this handoff explicitly lists which of INV-1..INV-8 apply and why, per its own requirement.
invariant_assessment.INV-7_no_sql_string_interpolation: APPLIES (live) but NOT TRIGGERED -- grep -n "Repo.query" lib/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox.ex returned zero hits; no SQL of any form appears in this diff's lib/ or migrations/ files (no migrations touched).
invariant_assessment.INV-8_no_unhandled_crashes_on_realistic_: APPLIES (live) and SATISFIED -- grep -n "^\\s*{:ok, .*} = " lib/letflow/engine/lua/sandbox.ex returned zero hits. Sandbox.new/0,1 has no external I/O, no config lookup, and no user input at construction time (per design INV-SBX-4 and the moduledoc's own statement), so there is no fallible external call for this invariant to guard against; construction correctly returns a bare Lua.t() rather than a fabricated {:ok,_} that could mask a failure mode that does not exist.
